name: saas-landing
title: Leo's starter: SaaS landing page
description: A studio-grade landing page you can sell from: three.js hero, pinned product story, product tour tabs, logo and quote marquees, pricing with a monthly and yearly toggle, FAQ and a working waitlist. All copy lives in one config file.
stack: Web Animations API, CSS transitions and View Transitions (no animation library)
features: Working waitlist: POST /api/waitlist with validation, honeypot and rate limiting
Signups saved to data/waitlist.json, optional webhook forwarding via WAITLIST_WEBHOOK_URL
All copy, pricing, story screens and tour tabs in src/config/site.ts
Lazy loaded three.js hero that reacts to pointer and scroll, pauses off screen, static fallback
Pinned product story: the product window swaps screens as the steps scroll past
Product tour with accessible tabs (arrow keys, Home, End)
Logo and quote marquees in CSS, paused on hover and focus
Cursor-follow glow on cards, pointer devices only
Section transitions, nav scroll-spy and a view-transition theme switch
Light and dark theme with no flash; reduced motion respected everywhere
Metadata, generated Open Graph image, sitemap.xml and robots.txt
Governor pre-installed: AI coding guardrails for Claude Code (tier 3)

demo.try: Enter an email in the hero form and press Join the waitlist. The signup appears in data/waitlist.json.

thirdPartyNotes: All runtime dependencies are MIT; fonts are OFL 1.1; Governor is MIT. See NOTICE.md.
